items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I think the whole pivot was on a guy by the name of Victor Feldman because he was in my band 20 years ago.

ctx.x: Yeah, he picked two people -- two or three which had been former writers of mine, but he felt that they were in a position to cope with these pieces and so on, and they would be -- for instance, just to give you, like, the people that I think that made the biggest impact, that had been able to put the idea together, they had to be Alan Broadbent, it had to be Bill Stapleton and I think the whole pivot was on a guy by the name of Victor Feldman because he was in my band 20 years ago.
